item.title: [IGNITE-718] NPE in query.
item.description:
In ignite-692 branch:

  1. Run VisorTesterLauncher
  2. Run Visor
  3. Execute query: 
    Select * from "c_partitioned2".Car a, "c_partitioned".country, "c_partitioned".organization inner join "c_partitioned2".car b

Receive log on node:

[16:16:27,385][WARNING][ignite-#190%rest-visor-tester-DC1%][IgniteH2Indexing] Query execution is too long [time=3475 ms, sql='SELECT
    CAST(__C0 AS UUID) _KEY,
    __C1 _VAL,
    CAST(__C2 AS UUID) ID,
    __C3 NAME,
    CAST(__C4 AS UUID),
    __C5,
    CAST(__C6 AS UUID),
    __C7,
    CAST(__C8 AS UUID),
    __C9,
    CAST(__C10 AS UUID),
    __C11,
    CAST(__C12 AS UUID),
    __C13,
    CAST(__C14 AS UUID),
    __C15
FROM PUBLIC.__Z0()', plan=
SELECT
    CAST(__C0 AS UUID) AS _KEY,
    __C1 AS _VAL,
    CAST(__C2 AS UUID) AS ID,
    __C3 AS NAME,
    CAST(__C4 AS UUID),
    __C5,
    CAST(__C6 AS UUID),
    __C7,
    CAST(__C8 AS UUID),
    __C9,
    CAST(__C10 AS UUID),
    __C11,
    CAST(__C12 AS UUID),
    __C13,
    CAST(__C14 AS UUID),
    __C15
FROM PUBLIC.__Z0()
    /* function */
, parameters=[]]
